old: return w.off <= n && w.len <= n - w.off
new: return w.off <= n && w.len <= n - w.off + 1u32

name: W2 a window may start at any offset
old: return w.off <= n && w.len <= n - w.off

name: W3 get does not check the window against the buffer

name: W4 get allows the index one past the window
old:
if i >= w.len { return Err<u32,u32>(2u32) }
  return buffer.read_u8(b, w.off + i)
new:
if i > w.len { return Err<u32,u32>(2u32) }
  return buffer.read_u8(b, w.off + i)

name: W5 put does not check the window against the buffer
new:
if i >= w.len { return Err<u32,u32>(2u32) }
  return buffer.write_u8(b, w.off + i, v)

name: W6 put allows the index one past the window
old:
if i >= w.len { return Err<u32,u32>(2u32) }
  return buffer.write_u8(b, w.off + i, v)
new:
if i > w.len { return Err<u32,u32>(2u32) }
  return buffer.write_u8(b, w.off + i, v)

old: right: Window { off: w.off + at, len: w.len - at }

name: W9 the right half of a split keeps the whole length
old: right: Window { off: w.off + at, len: w.len - at } })
new: right: Window { off: w.off + at, len: w.len } })
